chick_ra_fgf_somites_specimen.species: Gallus gallus (chick embryo dorsal SEM showing anterior RALDH2-expressing segmented somites, central neural tube, determination front bistable switch zone, and posterior FGF8/Wnt presomitic mesoderm)

goldbeter_baker_2006_2007_governing_equa.section: Goldbeter, Gonze & Pourquie (2007) Dev. Cell / Dev. Dyn. 236:1495-1508 & Baker, Schnell & Maini (2006) J. Theor. Biol. 239:413-429
goldbeter_baker_2006_2007_governing_equa.ra_reaction_diffusion_pde: dR/dt = D_R * d^2R/dx^2 + v_sc(x) - k_d1 * C(F) * R - k_d2 * R
goldbeter_baker_2006_2007_governing_equa.fgf_wnt_reaction_diffusion_pde: dF/dt = D_F * d^2F/dx^2 + k_s * M(x) * K_I^n / (K_I^n + R^n) - k_dF * F
goldbeter_baker_2006_2007_governing_equa.posterior_fgf8_mrna_gradient: M(x) = M_0 * exp(-x / lambda_M),  where lambda_M = v_g / k_dM
goldbeter_baker_2006_2007_governing_equa.front_sharpening_inequality: Delta_x_front << lambda_M  (bistable switch compresses the 10-90% determination front width >14-fold relative to the shallow exponential mRNA decay length)

canonical_parameters.species: Gallus gallus (2-day HH10-12 chick embryo presomitic mesoderm)

ra_fgf_wnt_experimental_perturbations.source: Goldbeter, Gonze & Pourquie (2007) Figs. 2-6; Diez del Corral et al. (2003) Neuron 40:65-79; Vermot & Pourquie (2005) Nature 435:215-220; Dubrulle et al. (2001) Cell 106:219-232

regimes.label: Wild-type chick PSM (opposing RALDH2/RA and FGF8/Wnt/CYP26A1 bistable switch)
Vitamin A Deficiency (VAD / Raldh2-/- attenuation, v_sc = 0.08 nM/min -> anterior front shift & small somites)
Exogenous Retinoic Acid treatment (elevated v_sc = 0.42 nM/min -> posterior front shift & enlarged somites)
SU5402 pharmacological FGFR1 inhibition (45% reduced FGF/Wnt signaling -> posterior front shift & large somites)
Ectopic FGF8-soaked bead graft in mid-PSM (anterior to bead: bistable switch retarded -> compressed somite)
